verdict.line: You lose if Ornn lands his Q slow into an E charge against terrain before level 6; you win if you survive that window, finish Heartsteel, and start forcing trades with Vorpal Spikes and Feral Scream once his Searing Charge is down.

brief.thesis: Ornn's Living Forge passive gives him bonus Armor and Magic Resist on top of a real engage chain — Q (Volcanic Rupture) slows, then E (Searing Charge) dashes and knocks up anyone caught against terrain — which is why he holds the lane and solo-kill edge (47.7% over 243 games) despite Cho'Gath sitting at a healthy 51.1% top-lane win rate overall. Cho's structural counter is range: Q (Rupture) reaches 950, farther than Ornn's Q (800) or E (450), and W (Feral Scream) can silence him out of a charge. The matchup is won by playing around his cooldowns, not by matching his combo head-on.

theirWindow.when: his Q hits and E is up near a wall
theirWindow.what: Volcanic Rupture's slow sets up Searing Charge's terrain knockup — back off or Flash away immediately rather than trying to trade through it.

yourWindow.what: Step up and auto-attack to proc Vorpal Spikes repeatedly; he has no gap-close or peel tool up, so this is your real trading window.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: Most-picked start on this lane (47.9% WR, 71.4% pick) — the mana and sustain matter because you're spending Q and E constantly to even out Ornn's poke advantage.

boots.why: Every one of Ornn's damaging abilities (Q, W, E, R) is magic — the flat magic resist directly shrinks his Q-E poke-into-engage combo (49% WR, 51.4% pick).

core.why: Health stacks come from autoattacking, which also procs Vorpal Spikes — it turns your forced trade windows into permanent stats that outlast Ornn's forge items.
Magic resist plus a damage-over-time field that punishes him for staying in range during his own E engage.
Grievous Wounds shuts down any self-sustain Ornn picks up, and the armor answers his auto-reliant E/W pressure (66.7% WR in this build path).

if the game goes long and teamfights are deciding it
if you need a gap-close onto backline instead of more tankiness
if you need to catch up to peel or split-push

runes.keystoneWhy: The attack-speed burst lines up with Vorpal Spikes' on-attack trigger, so your trading window during his E cooldown does the most damage possible before he can reset — this page runs 62.8% win rate.

summoners.why: Teleport (72.7% pick) lets you reset after losing an early trade to his Q-E combo and come back scaled into your Heartsteel power spike; Flash+Ignite (49.2% WR) is the alternative if you're ahead and want to close out kills off Rupture into Feral Scream.

playing.title: Hold Q for his engage
playing.detail: Rupture's 950 range outreaches both his Q (800) and E (450) — use it to interrupt his charge before he closes the distance rather than only as poke.

playing.title: Track his Searing Charge cooldown
playing.detail: It's his only gap-close and knockup. Once he's used it, you can step up safely for 12-14 seconds.

playing.title: Stay in range for Vorpal Spikes
playing.detail: The spikes trigger on every auto, so standing and trading continuously does more damage than spacing in and out.

playing.title: Don't fight him against walls
playing.detail: His E only knocks up on terrain collision, so backing into open lane removes that half of his combo entirely.

playing.title: Silence through his charge-up
playing.detail: Feral Scream has a 13s cooldown and 300 range — save it to cancel his E or R recast rather than opening with it.

playing.title: Feast for true damage, not just the kill
playing.detail: Feast's true damage is strong as a trade tool even when you can't secure the kill; every kill does add a permanent HP stack (max 6).

playing.title: Play for the level 9-13 spike
playing.detail: This is where Heartsteel comes online and his forge-item resistances stop scaling as fast — push trades here rather than at level 3-5.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoner spells, and all win rates are measured from live Cho'Gath vs Ornn games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning behind each recommendation is my own read of the kit, not part of the measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with his (Q)-(E) combo. Use [Q][W] to contest lane while focusing on pushing lane. Use your lane sustain to gain control over lane.
